project.name: Team File Drop
project.description: A simple internal tool for small teams to share files quickly, with links that expire after 7 days.
project.problem: Teams lose files in email threads and Slack; there is no single, link-based place to drop and fetch shared files.
goals: Share a file with anyone via a link that expires
Keep large files from clogging email
successCriteria: A user uploads a file, gets a shareable link, and a teammate can download it after 7 days without account sign-in
userStories: As a designer, I can drop a 200MB mockup and send a link that works for a week.

features.name: Upload and link
features.description: Upload a file and get a short-lived shareable link.

features.name: Expiring links
features.description: Links expire after a configurable window (default 7 days).

requirements.title: Users can upload files up to 2GB
requirements.description: Support multipart uploads for files up to 2GB.

requirements.title: Expiring links stop working after their window
requirements.description: Expired links return a clear 410 Gone response.

decisions.decision: Store files in object storage (S3-compatible); keep only a record of them in PostgreSQL.
decisions.reason: Files are large and transient; object storage is cheaper and scales.

assumptions.statement: Downloaders do not need an account.
assumptions.reason: The goal is frictionless sharing via link.

assumptions.statement: Files are deleted automatically when links expire.

architecture.backend: Next.js API routes for upload/download link generation.
architecture.auth: No auth for downloaders; upload limited to authenticated team members.

security.authModel: Team members sign in; download links are unguessable and expiring.
security.accessControl: Only the uploader or a team member can view uploads made by the team.
security.sensitiveData: File bytes in object storage; link tokens hashed at rest.
